Have only had this one a short time. It replaced a Genesis II, which had serious corrosion issues, probably self induced as I left it on the patio under an eave, but without a cover.

This Spirit E-310 heats up faster than the Genesis and achieves a higher max temperature, especially notable at grill height. Therefore it seems to have a clear edge in grilling steak/hamburgers etc. Only a bit smaller cooking area, so it meets our needs from that point of view as well.

Did a bit of research re grill covers, where there is a very active online market, and finally decided on the new design Weber Grill cover. You can spend more money and buy a heavier cover, but, living  in South Florida, I judged the breathability of the Weber cover’s new materials to be a better solution. The three year warranty matches up competitively.

Results.ReviewText:
This is my first Weber grill purchase. The build quality of this grill is far superior to its competitors. The assembly instructions are also precise and all pieces fit exactly, with no sharp or uneven edges. 
I used it a few times already. This grill heats up very quickly compared to other brand grills I had in the past. My only complain is that the temperature tends to stay too high on the lowest heat settings with the lid closed. This tells me that it keeps the heat insulated which is good. However, I would like to see a lower burner setting that could keep the heat 350-400F instead of the 500F. As a workaround, I simply shut off the middle burner keeping the outer burners on the lowest setting OR pop the lid open from time to time to release some of the heat.
Results.Title: Solid built Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I'm not "thrilled" with your new system of weighing propane volume. It constantly has to be physically moved before it indicates the weight of the remaining propane and it never shows the "Red" indicator in the same place as the prior shaking effort. 
  In addition; the two buffer pads that kept the tank from dragging on or scratching the unit had to be removed because they kept catching on the tank weld seam.
My old barbecue's visual  ( Green, Yellow, Red ) indicator was clearly more accurate.
Other than that "little" issue, it does cook food faster and more uniformly than our old one so I guess we'll keep it

Results.ReviewText: We bought the Spirit ll E-310 about a month and have used it several times.  It heats up very quickly and cooks evenly.  It took about four hours to put together, but all the parts fit together very well.  There was a pin missing out of the lid, but Weber sent it to me very quickly.  I do think there should be two screws in each of the four pieces that make up the bottom shelf so they would all set level without moving: however, it doesn’t really affect anything.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This grill is a replacement for an older Weber grill and it doesn't cook the same.
This grill has cooking directions for an assortment of food but it doesn't use temperature as the guide, only heat settings (low, medium and high) of the burners
with either direct or indirect heating.  Tried using the recommended setting, but the food isn't cooked enough. Makes one wonder why they have a built-in thermometer in the cover!?

The side gas tank attachment really helps when changing canisters.  Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this a few weeks ago for a cookout that day, and it has been a pleasure to use. Starts right up, heats up nicely (and really cranks out the heat if you want it), cleans up well, seems well put together.  Well designed with two side tables, very easy to move around and use, controls work as they should.  Only very minor issue is that the cover on one of the wheels keeps popping off.  Otherwise it's perfect!  We have had good experience with Weber (both in quality and customer service) before, and wanted to get another Weber for that reason.  So far I'm very happy!

Results.ReviewText:
It grills fine, bit the cheap construction is surprising for the price and brand reputation.  The lack of wheels on the left side and the fold away tray on the same side, makes moving it a chore.  The fold away mechanism is just two screws that the slots on the tray "fall" into and is very cheap.  Materials are thin, lid does not sit square on top (wobbles when closed) and Weber does not really stand behind it, doesn't really care and takes a long time to respond.  

Sold it two weeks after buying it and lost $200.  Not at all worth it.  Look into the Genesis or used Weber.
Results.Title: Too much money for what you get, not worth it

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
